decisive_items: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.
The mass was accompanied by slight pain that worsened around menstruation.
response.rationale: Histopathology confirms endometrial tissue; subcutaneous location in the abdominal wall with a prior surgical scar and cyclic pain strongly support abdominal wall endometrioma, which is more specific than general abdominal endometriosis.

rejected.why: Lacks location specificity; endometrioma without specifying abdominal wall is less precise.
Too broad; does not specify the abdominal wall location.
